SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wal:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.
This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER who taught WALLACE.
But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.
How strong could they be?
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Eve:
Everyone in town has taken refuge and won't come out of their homes.
Even I would rather not venture outside.
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Alw:
Whenever, wherever, and whatever happens, I will always be friends with POKéMON.
Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Are:
Aren't POKéMON our friends?
Why are they going wild this way?
